title: statement block props
description: A statement (« Énoncé »): the one idea of a page to remember, set large. Presentations: statement (large text), ruled (between two rules), quote (a quotation mark before it) and image (over a picture, edge to edge, on the theme's scrim). With an author it is a quotation in every presentation: a figure with its blockquote and a caption naming the author, their role, and an optional round portrait.
x-ai-instructions: One statement per page at most, for the idea the learner must keep (a rule, a principle, the takeaway of a case), in one or two sentences. Never repeat a sentence of the page as a pull quote: a statement whose words are also in a text block of the screen is reported (W_QUOTE_REPEATS); say it once, here or there. A quotation needs a real author (author, role) and the exact words. Use the image presentation only with a photograph that carries the idea, and keep the text short: elabora fit measures its contrast on the scrim. When the plan has a locked text, use textRef.

presentation.description: statement: large text; ruled: between two rules; quote: a quotation mark before it; image: over image, edge to edge of the window (of the slide in slides), on the theme's scrim.

markdown.description: The statement, one or two sentences. Use markdown or textRef, not both.

textRef.description: Id of a validated text of the plan: the statement shows the plan's wording.

author.description: Who said or wrote it: the statement becomes a quotation (figure, blockquote, caption).

role.description: With author: who they are (their role, a book, a date).

portrait.description: With author: a portrait shown round beside the caption. Decorative: the caption names the person.

image.description: image presentation: the picture under the text.

alt.description: image presentation: what the picture shows. Required unless decorative is true.

decorative.description: image presentation: true when the picture carries no information beyond the text.

generated.description: True if the picture or the portrait was produced by an AI model; the player shows a mark and the build report lists it.

focus.description: image presentation: where the subject of the picture is, kept in view when it is cropped.

align.description: Where the text sits: centred, or at the start of the line.
